name: Investigation Rejection 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for rejecting an investigation case.

NFND.name: Underlying Payment Not Found
NFND.definition: Underlying instruction can not be found.

NAUT.name: Not Authorised To Investigate
NAUT.definition: Case assignee is not allowed to investigate on this instruction or a party has been by-passed in the payment chain or no bilateral agreement has been established for this type of query.

UKNW.name: Unknown Case
UKNW.definition: Case has never been assigned before.

PCOR.name: Payment Previously Cancelled Or Rejected
PCOR.definition: Used when the payment instruction has previously been cancelled or rejected.

WMSG.name: Wrong Message
WMSG.definition: Wrong message has been used in the investigation workflow.

RNCR.name: Reject Non Cash Related
RNCR.definition: Used to reject a non-cash related query that is not covered in the workflow.

MROI.name: Missing Resolution Of Investigation
MROI.definition: Resolution of Investigation has not been received on reopened case.
